notes:
Lead source: organic inbound (signup). Company: PebbleFlight — seed-stage B2B SaaS (in-app assistant for workspace apps). Small engineering team (CTO Alex Moreno + 2 frontend, 1 backend), experimenting with Redwood hosted API for quick proof-of-concept.

Product/requirements summary:
- Primary workload: low-latency in-app chat with streaming responses; want smooth token-by-token UI experience.
- Target SLAs: first-byte streaming <150ms in NA, typical turn latency sub-300ms for short replies, p95 throughput ~20 reqs/sec initial.
- Model preferences: open models (gpt-like open weights) or Redwood-curated small variants for cost; want automated fallback to lighter model when load spikes.
- Cost sensitivity: tight runway, wants clear per-token cost calc and guidance on batching/caching to stay within $2k/mo credit.
- Integration: React front-end using WebSocket/SSE; backend in Node (express). Requests will come from browser via backend proxy.
- Security: SMB needs SSO/SAML later, audit logs now; basic SOC2 questions but not blocking immediate POC. No on-prem preference — public cloud fine.

Call notes (shorthand):
- Alex: "We need streaming to feel instant — users drop off if first bytes >200ms."
- Wants sample app with Node streaming + reconnection logic.
- Interested in Redwood's streaming SDK and cost controls; asked about prefix caching + KV cache hints.
- Wants fallback policy examples (how to route to a cheaper model gracefully).

POC plan proposed:
- Week 0: provide trial credits + Node streaming quickstart repo, example SSE/WebSocket flow.
- Week 1: integrate hosted API in their staging, measure tail latency (p50/p95).
- Week 2: tune batching/caching, evaluate cost/quality tradeoffs, demo to product team.

Open questions / blockers:
- Need verification for p95 latency numbers in NA (Redwood perf bench vs their real app).
- Legal: quick DPA / retention policy example to satisfy small-corp counsel.
- Token cost projection: they asked for a 3-month estimate for typical chat volume (~50k msg/mo).

Stated next steps (from AE): "Send the Node streaming snippet + small React demo, bump trial credits to $1k, schedule POC kickoff with eng (opt: include SE for first 45m)."
